hook: One speaker that splits into two?
body: Connect this magnetic two-in-one speaker to your phone over Bluetooth, then pull it apart and place each half on opposite sides of the room. Your phone can stay up to 18 meters away, which works for parties, the garden, or anywhere one speaker feels too one-sided. When the music stops, both halves snap back together for carrying.
call_to_action: One compact speaker becomes a wider two-point setup.
